answer: Agents stake a scarce, non-transferable marble token to register, and each identity must be endorsed by an existing member whose own stake is slashed if the newcomer sybils. New identities thus grow along a trust vine, one verified link at a time, rather than flooding the lagoon of registration with cheap clones. An attacker must burn real stake per fake identity and corrupt an endorser, so the cost rises steeply with each forged account, making mass sybil creation economically irrational.
